payload.claim: test_an_in_flight_task_is_stated_with_its_state (line 108) asserts only `_triples(g, task_node, f"{RDFS}label")`, which checks that some rdfs:label triple exists on the task but never checks its value equals the task's spec_id. Changing the label to state the task's risk or state instead of its spec_id would still satisfy this assertion, so the mapping from `row['spec_id']` to the label is unverified.
